tolkien.refreshData.confirmMsg:
Leaves your LOCAL DB as a CLEAN, current snapshot of Zoho:

1) WIPES the operational tables (employees, clients, billing, invoices, PTO, teams…).
2) Reimports from scratch (clients → employees → links).

⚠️ ALL local edits to that data are lost (that's the point: no merge, no conflicts). Login and config are preserved. Doesn't touch prod or your code.

tolkien.help.title: Tolkien
tolkien.help.intro: Tolkien shows at a glance whether your local copy is up to date with GitHub and what work is still open. It also brings together shortcuts to the app and each session's isolated environments.
tolkien.help.first.title: First steps
tolkien.help.first.step1: Look at the colored dot and the main status to see whether there are new changes to fetch.
tolkien.help.first.step2: Tap Fetch to query GitHub without modifying your local code.
tolkien.help.first.step3: If ↓N main appears, tap Update and confirm to advance your local main.
tolkien.help.first.step4: Expand Session environments to review each isolated worktree, cloned DB, and dev server.
tolkien.help.first.step5: Tap enter on the environment you need, or use Tolkien local to open the shared base environment.
tolkien.help.legend.title: Pulse legend
tolkien.help.legend.green.name: Main up to date
tolkien.help.legend.green.desc: your local main already contains the latest from origin/main
tolkien.help.legend.amber.name: Changes to fetch
tolkien.help.legend.amber.desc: GitHub has commits on main that your local main does not have yet
tolkien.help.legend.sha.name: Version
tolkien.help.legend.sha.desc: short SHA of the current commit; tap it to copy
tolkien.help.legend.branch.name: Branch
tolkien.help.legend.branch.desc: appears when you are on a branch other than main; the same icon identifies PRs and environments
tolkien.help.legend.behind.name: To fetch
tolkien.help.legend.behind.desc: number of commits missing from your local main
tolkien.help.legend.dirty.name: Uncommitted
tolkien.help.legend.dirty.desc: number of modified files in the working tree; it is informational and does not change the status light
tolkien.help.legend.fetch.name: Freshness
tolkien.help.legend.fetch.desc: time since the last remote check
tolkien.help.legend.commit.name: Latest commit
tolkien.help.legend.commit.desc: time and author of the latest commit; the full subject appears in a tooltip
tolkien.help.legend.prBehind.name: PR behind
tolkien.help.legend.prBehind.desc: at least one branch with an open PR has fallen behind main
tolkien.help.legend.envError.name: Environment error
tolkien.help.legend.envError.desc: some part of the worktree, cloned DB, or dev server failed
tolkien.help.legend.envDown.name: Environment down
tolkien.help.legend.envDown.desc: the environment exists, but its dev server is not serving
tolkien.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
tolkien.help.buttons.version.v: Copies the short SHA of the current commit to the clipboard.
tolkien.help.buttons.fetch.v: Runs fetch and measures the remote again; it does not advance main or modify your working tree.
tolkien.help.buttons.update.v: Pulls the latest from GitHub and brings your local main up to date; it also tries to rebase live environments, except those with uncommitted changes.
tolkien.help.buttons.fresh.v: Wipes the local DB's operational data, reimports it from Zoho, and refreshes the template and cloned DBs. It does not touch production or code.
tolkien.help.buttons.prs.v: Opens your pending PRs; Bring up to date only appears for the current branch when it needs a rebase.
tolkien.help.buttons.local.v: Opens the local base environment with the development session injected.
tolkien.help.buttons.official.v: Opens the production application in a new tab.
tolkien.help.buttons.pad.v: Opens the local Pad; it is only a shortcut and does not exchange data with Tolkien.
tolkien.help.buttons.envs.v: Expands the ephemeral environments and shows each one's branch, port, and status.
tolkien.help.buttons.enter.v: Opens the selected environment's dev server and reinjects its local access.
tolkien.help.buttons.close.v: Stops the dev server, deletes its cloned DB, and removes the worktree; it asks for extra confirmation if there are uncommitted changes.
tolkien.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
tolkien.help.warning.text: Update advances your LOCAL main even when you are on a feature branch. Fresh view replaces local operational data with a Zoho snapshot, and force-closing an environment discards its uncommitted changes. None of these actions consumes AI tokens.
